asOf.description: Database statement time, not an ingestion or price freshness guarantee.

assets.description: Ordered by assetId. Includes all recorded assets, even with zero holdings.

calculationMode.description: Always demo. The 85% LTV and 90% liquidation threshold do not grant authorization.

complete.description: False when a nonzero holding or liability has no price. Affected totals are null.

netEquityUsd.description:
Gross booked portfolio value, before debt, as requested for the demo.
Excludes pending deposits, principal liabilities and provider shortfalls.

debitQuantity.description: Accounting posting totals in atomic units, not cash-flow labels.

quantityChange.description: Signed change in token units: debits minus credits, except liabilities use credits minus debits.

changes.description: All user-owned bucket changes. System and other users' postings are omitted.

status.description: Deposit phase at this event, otherwise "recorded". Not a current settlement status.

timestamp.description: Journal recording time in Unix milliseconds; determines page order.

type.description: Display category; commandKind retains the exact Ledger event.

buckets.description:
Recorded Ledger buckets: pending, available, reserved, order_reserved,
withdrawal_reserved, hyperliquid_margin, principal_liability,
liquidation_proceeds, customer_surplus, provider_shortfall.

caip19.description: CAIP-19 token identity from the locked asset registry.

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain identity from the locked asset registry.

oneOf.description: Streamed Risk configuration, not user eligibility; null when not configured.

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 contract or SPL mint address; null for native assets.

assets.description: Complete catalog in registry order; CAIP-19 identifies each representation.

creditQuantity.description: Cumulative credit postings in atomic units, as an exact unsigned integer string.

debitQuantity.description: Cumulative debit postings in atomic units, as an exact unsigned integer string.

updatedAt.description: Last stored balance update in Unix milliseconds, not external ingestion freshness.

assetId.description: Ledger accounting code; null when this asset is supported only by Risk.

caip19.description: Canonical or provisional CAIP-19 asset identity.

oneOf.description: Streamed Risk settings; null when no collateral configuration exists.

economicAsset.description: Grouping across chains; does not make balances interchangeable.

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 contract or SPL mint; null for native and HIP-1 assets.

lowerBoundNotional.description: Inclusive notional bound, converted exactly from the registry's 1e8 fixed point.

maxLeverage.description: Configured tier leverage, not the leverage available to a particular user.

externalId.description: Configured source-specific feed identifier; no live price is included.

CollateralConfig.description: Asset-level configuration, not user eligibility or a borrowing limit.

enabled.description: Whether the streamed Risk model enables standalone collateral for this asset.

factor.description: Exact valuation multiplier, e.g. "0.950000"; not a credit LTV.

evmAddress.description: Provisioned EVM wallet address in lowercase hex; null when no wallet is provisioned.

solanaAddress.description: Provisioned Solana wallet public key in base58; null when no wallet is provisioned.

samples.description: Newest first, with sample ID breaking capture-time ties.

truncated.description: Narrow the requested range or increase limit when true. No silent truncation.

health.description: Exact finite ratio as a decimal string; null for incomplete or unbounded health.

inputFreshness.description: Always unknown: the current stream carries sequences, not source observation times.

oneOf.description: Missing when this user has no captured history. No fabricated healthy default.

LinkIdentityResponse.description:
The identity mapping as a plain resource; `201` versus `200` tells the
operator whether this call created the link.

markets.description: Complete configured perpetual-market list in registry order.

inviteCode.description: Shared invite code; maximum 128 UTF-8 bytes, no surrounding whitespace or control characters.

expiresAt.description: Access JWT expiry in Unix milliseconds.

refreshExpiresAt.description: Fixed session expiry in Unix milliseconds.

ltv.description: Demo rate for every asset, regardless of collateral configuration.

priceAsOf.description: Aggregate computation time; null for a registry fixed price or missing aggregate.

priceUsd.description: Registry fixed USD price or latest aggregate without a freshness cutoff; null if missing.

quantity.description: Net included holdings in token units. Bucket totals remain atomic integer strings.

valueUsd.description: USD values are decimal strings with eight fractional digits, truncated toward zero.

AccessCookie.description: Core-issued access JWT. HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api. Do not combine with bearer authentication.
AccessCookie.name: __Secure-tackt-access

OperatorBearer.description: Shared CORE_API_OPERATOR_TOKEN, separate from user JWTs.

RefreshCookie.description: Rotating opaque refresh credential; an access JWT is not required.
RefreshCookie.name: __Secure-tackt-refresh

UserId.description: UUID matching the verified JWT subject; required only with UserBearer.
UserId.name: X-User-Id

info.description: Core-issued access JWTs last up to 15 minutes. Refresh sessions last 30 days. Logout blocks refresh immediately; issued access JWTs remain valid until expiry. User routes use camelCase and Unix-millisecond timestamps; legacy operator routes retain snake_case and RFC3339 timestamps.
